policy.stable: Supported for the whole 3.x series. Removing or changing the meaning of a stable name needs a major version (4.0) and a deprecation in a 3.x release first. New names may be added in any minor release.
policy.provisional: Public and supported, but its spelling or signature may change in a 3.x minor release. Each change is listed in CHANGELOG.md and bumps ALWAN_FOUNDATION_VERSION.
policy.internal: Not part of the foundation, whatever header it sits in. Changes without notice. A downstream library must not name it; tools/check_foundation_symbols.py fails if Suwar does.
policy.version_macro: ALWAN_FOUNDATION_VERSION (alwan_foundation_core.h) is an integer that increases with every change to a stable or provisional name. ALWAN_VERSION_MAJOR / MINOR / PATCH (alwan.h) version the library itself.
policy.abi: A library built on the foundation compiles alwan's cores into its own code (they are header-only and inline), so it must be rebuilt against the alwan headers it links with. Only the alwan_* functions declared in alwan.h are linked; their ABI follows the alwan.h rules (no enum renumbering and no struct layout change within 3.x).
policy.config: The precision switches (ALWAN_WITH_F32, ALWAN_WITH_F64) and ALWAN_DETERMINISTIC must have the same value in the library and in alwan. The installed alwan_build_config.h carries the precision switches; ALWAN_DETERMINISTIC reaches consumers as an INTERFACE compile definition of the exported alwan target. Do not redefine either on the command line.

groups.note: alwan_ctx_alloc / alwan_ctx_free are declared in alwan.h. NULL context means the default allocator.
